lines.en: label sportswars2:
scene mayanorikolockers1
A similar place at a similar time calls for a similar intro to the one you just got.
lines.zh: 相似的地点、相似的时间，自然也需要一段和你刚看过的差不多的开场白。

lines.en: Just, this time, we’ll talk about something a little different from “responsibility.”
lines.zh: 只不过这一次，我们要聊的东西和「责任」稍微有点不同。

lines.en: This time, we’ll talk about jealousy.
lines.zh: 这一次，我们要聊的是——嫉妒。

lines.en: Maya Makinami was a normal high school girl. Well, kind of. Actually, not really. Like, she was normal-ish. Especially now that her brain was a brain again.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 是个普通的高中女生。嗯，算是吧。其实，也不算。大概……勉强算普通。尤其是现在，她的脑子总算又变回脑子了。

lines.en: But she still enjoyed the way a specific adult male’s phallus felt inside of her, so she was about to embark on a journey to feel that again as that man was currently not being much of a man at all.
lines.zh: 可她依然喜欢某个成年男性的那话儿在她身体里的感觉，所以她正准备踏上一段旅程，去重新找回那种感觉——毕竟那个男人最近实在是一点男人样都没有。

lines.en: She was angry because of this. He’d ignored her before, but this time was different. And she wasn’t sure if Ami had anything to do with it, but she knew she’d have to confront her too as a part of this journey.
lines.zh: 她为此很生气。他以前也无视过她，但这一次不一样。她不确定 Ami 是否与此有关，但她知道，这段旅程里她也得去跟 Ami 对峙。

lines.en: That’s not who she was jealous of, though.
lines.zh: 不过，她嫉妒的并不是她。

lines.en: Her actual jealousy was focused at three other people. But, on the bright side, one of those people was dead.
lines.zh: 她真正嫉妒的是另外三个人。不过往好处想，其中一个已经死了。

lines.en: : Maya?...
lines.zh: : Maya？……

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers2
But two of them weren’t.
lines.zh: 但另外两个还活着。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers3
And one of them just so happens to be the real subject for event numero dos.
lines.zh: 而其中一位，恰好就是第二场事件真正的主角。

lines.en: Which, unfortunately, means Mayonnaise Macaroni is going to have to wait a little longer to be the center of attention again. But hey, she should be used to that by now.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，这意味着「蛋黄酱通心粉」还得再等一阵子，才能重新成为众人的焦点。不过话说回来，她早该习惯了吧。

lines.en: Or...shouldn’t be?
lines.zh: 或者……不该习惯？

lines.en: I don’t know. Do you think she’s retained any of her memories?
lines.zh: 我也不知道。你觉得她还留着过去的记忆吗？

lines.en: Or do you think that maybe she’s kind of always just been a bitch?
lines.zh: 还是说，你觉得她其实一直都是个婊子？

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene mayanorikolockers4
: Fuck. I thought if I stayed really still, you wouldn’t be able to see me.
lines.zh: : 操。我还以为只要一动不动，你就看不见我了。

lines.en: : Are you some kind of chameleon?
lines.zh: : 你是变色龙吗？

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers5
: It takes one to know one, you slimy whore.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此吧，你这黏糊糊的婊子。

lines.en: : Reptiles aren’t slimy. That’s more of an amphibian thing. If anything, chameleons feel more leathery than-
lines.zh: : 爬行动物才不黏糊。那是两栖动物的事。真要说的话，变色龙的手感更接近皮革——

lines.en: : Why are you talking to me? Why are you looking at me? I’m clearly busy.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛跟我说话？干嘛盯着我看？我明显忙着呢。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers6
: Busy doing what? Because it’s sports day and it looks kind of like you’re getting ready to leave.
lines.zh: : 忙什么？今天可是运动会，而你看上去像是要准备开溜。

lines.en: : Well, aren’t you just an expert at deductive reasoning?
lines.zh: : 哟，你真是演绎推理的专家啊。

lines.en: : You’re just going to leave your friends behind when they’re counting on you? Seriously?
lines.zh: : 大家都在指望你，你就这么把她们丢下？认真的？

lines.en: Despite directly asking Maya about her intentions, Noriko already knew the answer.
lines.zh: 虽然直接问了 Maya 的打算，Noriko 其实早就知道答案。

lines.en: She just preferred to look to the positive side of things, and sincerely hoped her “rival” would see the errors of her ways if they were just pointed out to her enough.
lines.zh: 她只是习惯往好处看，并真心希望只要把话说得够透，这位「宿敌」就能意识到自己的错。

lines.en: But that wasn’t the type of girl her “rival” was.
lines.zh: 可她的「宿敌」偏偏不是那种女生。

lines.en: : They’ll figure out a way to win without me. It’s no big deal.
lines.zh: : 没有我，她们也能想办法赢。没什么大不了的。

lines.en: Her rival was selfish. Stubborn. She was simple-minded, yet passionate to a point where it felt almost like some sort of over-exaggerated character flaw.
lines.zh: 她的宿敌自私又固执。她头脑简单，却热烈到近乎夸张，简直像某种被放大过的性格缺陷。

lines.en: But despite feeling the negativity oozing out of those unfortunate traits, Noriko was jealous of her as well. And she frequently wondered what it would be like to not assume the role of a martyr every morning.
lines.zh: 尽管那些糟糕的特质不断渗出负能量，Noriko 依然嫉妒她。她常常想，如果自己不必每天早上都扮演殉道者，会是什么感觉。

lines.en: This is what made the two rivals in the first place — that mutual jealousy and unspoken respect, pumped with negative connotations that seemed more like embalming fluid the longer it kept their hatred from decaying.
lines.zh: 正因如此，这两人从一开始就成了宿敌——那份相互的嫉妒与心照不宣的敬意，注满了负面意味，越是阻止她们之间的恨意腐烂，就越像是一针防腐剂。

lines.en: : Then, do you mind if I take a guess as to where you’re going?
lines.zh: : 那么，我猜猜你要去哪儿，你不介意吧？

lines.en: It would have to decay eventually, though...wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: 不过，它总有一天会腐烂的……会吧？

lines.en: : I do, actually. I’ve already had to fend off one interrogation today and I’d much prefer to not go over my quota.
lines.zh: : 我介意。今天我已经被迫应付过一轮盘问了，实在不想超额。

lines.en: After all, the two of them weren’t all that different from one another.
lines.zh: 毕竟，她们俩其实没那么不同。

lines.en: They loved the same man. They were interested in the same avant-garde literature. Even their Internet histories were mostly congruous.
lines.zh: 她们爱着同一个男人。她们对同一类前卫文学感兴趣。连上网记录都大体吻合。

lines.en: But, most importantly of all, they shared the same fear — each other.
lines.zh: 但最重要的是，她们有着共同的恐惧——彼此。

lines.en: Right now, one of them was terrified.
lines.zh: 此刻，其中一个正吓得要命。

lines.en: And the other was simply...
lines.zh: 而另一个，只是……

lines.en: Nostalgic.
lines.zh: 感到怀念。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers7
: Hah...
: Does that sigh mean I’m free to go now? Or are you planning on telling Miss Imai about this the second I walk through those doors?
lines.zh: : 你这一声叹气，是表示我可以走了？还是打算等我前脚跨进那扇门，你就去向 Imai 老师告状？

lines.en: : I’m not going to tell on you, Maya. And I doubt Imani would give a shit even if I did.
lines.zh: : 我不会去告你的状，Maya。而且就算我告了，Imani 大概也不会在乎。

lines.en: : I’m sighing because I’m disappointed.
lines.zh: : 我叹气，是因为我很失望。

lines.en: : And...I’m supposed to care about that?
lines.zh: : 所以呢……我该在乎吗？

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers8
: No...I just mean that it sucks you’ve managed to make it this far without finding even one more thing you want to protect.
lines.zh: : 不……我只是觉得，你都走到这一步了，却还是没能再多找到一样想要守护的东西，这挺可悲的。

lines.en: : You want to know what sucks even more? A creepy stalker who transfers into my school so she can try and fuck my teacher. That sucks. And it goes against what we agreed. So die.
lines.zh: : 想知道更可悲的是什么吗？一个变态跟踪狂转学到我的学校，就为了能睡我的老师。这才叫可悲。而且这违背了我们说好的。所以你去死吧。

lines.en: : We were kids, Maya. We said and agreed to a lot of things we didn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 那会儿我们还是小孩，Maya。我们说过、答应过太多自己根本不明白的事。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers9
: But not all of us did things we didn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 但不是所有人都会去做自己不明白的事。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers10
: So, when you and Akira are alone, what’s it like?
lines.zh: : 那么，你和 Akira 独处的时候，是什么感觉？

lines.en: : We’re supposed to call him “Sensei.”
lines.zh: : 我们应该叫他「Sensei」才对。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers11
: Ugh! You’re gonna make me do that too? It’s bad enough hearing it from him all the time. The last thing I need is you hopping on the same bandwagon of boredom.
lines.zh: : 呜啊！连你也要这么叫？天天听他这么喊已经够受的了，我最不需要的就是你也跳上这趟无聊的顺风车。

lines.en: : Can you please stop talking now? I’m trying to study.
lines.zh: : 你能不能别说了？我要学习。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers10
: But we’re supposed to be studying together.
lines.zh: : 可我们说好要一起学习的。

lines.en: : Sure. But I don’t want to study together. You never take anything seriously and you talk way too much. It’s annoying. You’re annoying. So die.
lines.zh: : 说好是这么说。可我不想跟你一起学。你什么事都不认真，话还特别多。烦死了。你很烦。所以你去死吧。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers12
: Why do you always have to be so mean to me? I’m just trying to make conversation.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛总对我这么刻薄？我只是想跟你聊聊天而已。

lines.en: : No, you’re trying to make weird conversation about Sensei and me being alone together. It’s a leading question and I’m not going to fall into whatever trap allows you to extort information out of me.
lines.zh: : 不，你是想聊些关于我和 Sensei 独处的怪问题。这是诱导性提问，我不会掉进你设的套，让你从我这儿撬走情报。

lines.en: : Maya, you’re here every day. I can only come once or twice a week. You guys are alone a lot. And even when I’m here, you’re always getting special treatment.
lines.zh: : Maya，你每天都在这儿。我一周只能来一两次。你们独处的时间多得多。而且就算我在的时候，你也总是受到特殊待遇。

lines.en: : I’m getting special treatment? You keep calling him by his given name and he’s never even disciplined you for it. And that's not even counting how you’re always hanging all over him.
lines.zh: : 我受特殊待遇？你一直直呼他的名字，他却从来没为此罚过你。更别提你老是挂在他身上。

lines.en: : I’ve been hanging all over him since I was a baby. He’s basically my big brother. And he’s probably going to be my big brother one day if he and my sister get married.
lines.zh: : 我从还是婴儿的时候就挂在他身上了。他基本就是我哥哥。而且如果他和我姐姐结婚，他大概真会变成我哥哥。

lines.en: : If. Key word.
lines.zh: : 「如果」。关键词。

lines.en: : Would you rather it be you?
lines.zh: : 你希望那个人是你吗？

lines.en: : If I say yes, will you stop talking to me?
lines.zh: : 如果我说「是」，你就不跟我说话了吗？

lines.en: : No. I’ll probably press you even harder about what happens when you guys are alone.
lines.zh: : 不会。我大概还会变本加厉地追问你们独处时都干了什么。

lines.en: : Then I guess I’ll just shut my own mouth since you seem incapable of doing that.
lines.zh: : 那我看还是自己闭上嘴吧，毕竟你显然做不到。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers13
: Wanna know what he does with my sister when they’re alone?
lines.zh: : 想知道他和我姐姐独处的时候都做些什么吗？

lines.en: : They haven’t been “alone” for months. She’s a non-factor. And also, no. Because I would like to keep my lunch inside of my body.
lines.zh: : 他们已经好几个月没有「独处」了。她已经出局了。还有，不想听。因为我还想让午饭好好待在胃里。

lines.en: : She gives him “handjobs.” Do you know what those are, Maya? It’s when-
lines.zh: : 她会给他「打手枪」。你知道那是什么吗，Maya？就是——

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers14
: I don’t need you to tell me what they are! I’m not an idiot!
lines.zh: : 我不需要你告诉我那是什么！我又不是白痴！

lines.en: : Ooooooh? So you know already? Is that what you’re reading about over there? Practicing for having a boyfriend one day? No wonder why you want to study alone.
lines.zh: : 哦——？所以你早就知道了？你在那边看的就是这个？在为将来交男朋友做练习？怪不得你想一个人学习。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers15
: It’s only a matter of time until we start doing stuff like that, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们早晚也会开始做那种事的，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you think Akira might teach us about sex-ed next?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Akira 接下来会教我们性教育吗？

lines.en: : Shut up...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure there are other “jobs” too. I heard one of the girls in my class talking about “blowjobs” but I don’t think I get it yet. Like, do you just-
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定还有别的「活儿」。我听班上一个女生说过「口活」，但我还没搞懂。就是说，你是不是就——

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers16
: Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: : Jeez, Maya. You don’t have to yell at me.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Maya。你不用冲我吼吧。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers17
: Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: : Jeez, Maya. You don’t have to yell at me.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Maya。你不用冲我吼吧。

lines.en: : How can I not when you’re always such a presumptuous cunt?! You don’t know the first thing about what I did back then!
lines.zh: : 你总是这么自以为是的贱人，我怎么可能不吼？！你根本一点都不懂我当时经历了什么！

lines.en: : I mean...I might not have seen it. But the context clues at this point from both of you are no longer just a pile. It’s kind of like a big context...mountain.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我可能没亲眼看见。可你们俩给出的线索，到这会儿已经不止是「一堆」了。简直是一座……线索大山。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers18
: So what, then? Are you jealous? Are you just stopping me because you’re still petty about the way things ended up? You wish it were you instead?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你嫉妒了？你拦着我是因为对事情的结局还耿耿于怀？你希望那个人是你？

lines.en: : Maya...I am jealous about a lot of things.
lines.zh: : Maya……我嫉妒的东西有很多。

lines.en: : Your eyes....Your figure...Your confidence...
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛……你的身材……你的自信……

lines.en: : There are so many parts of you that I want for myself.
lines.zh: : 你身上有太多部分是我想要的。

lines.en: : But being molested is not one of them.
lines.zh: : 但「被猥亵」不在其中。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers19
: You have no fucking clue what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: : Now, if you’re done ruining my life, I would like to leave you with the same words I left Ayane with.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然你已经毁完我的人生，我想把留给 Ayane 的那句话也留给你。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers20
: Peace.
lines.zh: : 走好。

lines.en: : And also, die.
lines.zh: : 还有，去死。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers21
: Oh and good fucking luck or whatever. Hope you’re chosen for death ball.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，祝你他妈好运什么的。希望你能被选去打「死亡球」。

lines.en: : Death ball?
lines.zh: : 死亡球？

lines.en: scene black
: What the hell is death ball?
lines.zh: : 死亡球到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers22
: Hey, welcome back. I was beginning to think you weren’t going to join us this year. Which was kind of weird on account of how we walked to school together.
lines.zh: : 嘿，欢迎回来。我还以为你今年不打算参加了呢。想想还挺怪的，毕竟我们是一起走路来学校的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I had to show my friends around. And then I had to get dressed. And then I had to confront a ghost from my past who still haunts the halls of this very school.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我得先带朋友参观一圈。然后得换衣服。然后还得去面对一个至今仍在这所学校走廊里游荡的旧日幽灵。

lines.en: : Cool. I had tacos.
lines.zh: : 酷。我吃了塔可。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers23
: I want tacos. How come you always get to have all the fun while I’m stuck conquering demons?
lines.zh: : 我也想吃塔可。凭什么你总能享尽所有乐子，而我却要困在这儿降妖伏魔？

lines.en: : Because I’ve dedicated my life to doing whatever I want and you’ve dedicated yours to making other people happy for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 因为我这一生致力于为所欲为，而你这一生致力于让别人开心——也不知道图什么。

lines.en: : If you’ve dedicated your life to doing whatever you want, how come you’re not a stay-at-home mom packing lunches for our former teacher yet?
lines.zh: : 既然你一生致力于为所欲为，怎么还没变成给咱们前老师便当的全职妈妈？

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers24
: Stay-at-home mom? Oh, please. I’m just going to be the live-in housekeeper who fucks him while the wife is away and occasionally joins in for threesomes.
lines.zh: : 全职妈妈？得了吧。我只要当个住家保姆，趁老婆不在的时候跟他上床，偶尔再加入来一发三人行就行。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers25
: Does this mean I get to be the wife?!
lines.zh: : 那是不是说我可以当老婆？！

lines.en: : You’re probably the most likely to have a consensual threesome with me at this point, so yeah. Looks like you get to be the wife.
lines.zh: : 眼下你大概是最有可能跟我心甘情愿玩三人行的人，所以没错。看来老婆这个位子归你了。

lines.en: : And every Tuesday can be Taco Tuesday?!
lines.zh: : 那每个星期二都能是「塔可星期二」？！

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers26
: And every Tuesday can be Taco Tuesday.
lines.zh: : 每个星期二都是塔可星期二。

lines.en: : I’ve never been more excited to share the love of my life before. And that’s saying a lot because I do that every single day now.
lines.zh: : 我还从来没有这么兴奋地要和别人分享我一生的挚爱。这话很有分量，毕竟我现在每天都在分享了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, everyone you’re normally sharing him with is here. Minus the crazy niece and Yumi, that is.
lines.zh: : 还好，平时跟你分享他的那些人都在。除了那个疯疯癫癫的侄女和 Yumi 之外。

lines.en: : Yumi will be here. I texted her earlier.
lines.zh: : Yumi 会来的。我早些时候给她发过短信。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers27
: There’s someone else missing now, though. The first floor just lost Maya. And I highly doubt she’ll be coming back any time soon.
lines.zh: : 不过现在又少了一个人。一楼刚刚失去了 Maya。而且我非常怀疑她短期内不会回来。

lines.en: : Maya? Is that who you were talking about with that whole “ghost from your past” thing? The fuck is she doing bailing on the contest before it’s even gotten started?
lines.zh: : Maya？你说的那个「旧日幽灵」就是她？比赛都还没开始她就开溜，她到底在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: : Probably attempting the same thing you’ve been desperately holding yourself back from doing over the last few months in storming Sensei’s castle and attempting to claim his heart.
lines.zh: : 大概是在做你这几个月拼命忍住没做的事吧——强攻 Sensei 的城堡，试图夺下他的心。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers28
: On bloomer day? Lame. I only got to stare at her ass for like two minutes.
lines.zh: : 挑在运动短裤日？真逊。我才盯了她的屁股大概两分钟。

lines.en: : You can stare at my ass next. I think it’s a pretty good one.
lines.zh: : 那下一个你可以盯我的屁股。我觉得我的挺不错的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I see yours all the time. Maya’s ass is like filet mignon in that I rarely ever get to experience it and when I do, I want to take my time and enjoy it.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可你的我天天都能看。Maya 的屁股就像菲力牛排——难得尝到一回，一旦尝到了，就想慢慢享受。

lines.en: : Maya is technically my rival and I should be mad at you for saying this, but yeah. I get it.
lines.zh: : 严格来说 Maya 是我的宿敌，你说这话我该生气，不过……嗯，我懂。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers29
: You sure you’re okay with staying here, though? Because I wouldn’t blame you for chasing after her given that you are rivals and all.
lines.zh: : 不过你确定要留在这儿？毕竟你们是宿敌，你要是追出去，我也不会怪你。

lines.en: : There’s no point. I can never beat her head-to-head. She’s got too much of a lead.
lines.zh: : 没意义。正面交锋我永远赢不了她。她领先太多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’ve also been saying all that shit about how she’s been different lately. So maybe that won’t vibe with Sensei and he’ll decide he wants to fuck you more or something.
lines.zh: : 话是没错，可你也一直说她最近不太一样啊。说不定 Sensei 不吃这一套，然后决定多睡你几次什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m trying to think positive here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我在努力往好处想。

lines.en: : All things considered, this is probably the least weird thing she’s done lately. Doesn’t mean it isn’t annoying, though.
lines.zh: : 综合考虑，这大概是她最近干过最不奇怪的事了。不过这不代表不烦人。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers30
: Mood. Karin’s been like that lately too.
lines.zh: : 懂。Karin 最近也这样。

lines.en: : Karin? Like...like the Karin?
lines.zh: : Karin？就是……那个 Karin？

lines.en: : The one who shares my DNA? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 那个和我共享 DNA 的？对。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers31
: Well, what the fuck happened to her?! She can’t act weird! She’s our perfect little ball of sunshine!
lines.zh: : 那她到底出了什么事？！她不能变奇怪！她可是我们完美的小太阳！

lines.en: : First off, fuck you. But second, I have no fucking clue!
lines.zh: : 首先，去你的。其次，我他妈一点头绪都没有！

lines.en: : She just came home bawling her eyes out one day and won’t tell me what happened. She’s barely left the bedroom outside of going to school.
lines.zh: : 有一天她回家就哭得稀里哗啦，却不肯告诉我发生了什么。除了上学，她几乎没出过卧室。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers32
: I hope she didn’t see an animal get run over or something. I feel like that would greatly alter her path and turn her into something none of us are ready to console.
lines.zh: : 我希望她不是看到什么动物被车碾了之类的。我觉得那会彻底改变她的人生轨迹，把她变成我们谁都没准备好去安慰的样子。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers33
: No, I don’t think that’s it. This seems more, like...personal. She’d tell me about an animal getting hurt.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得不是。这事看起来更……私人一些。动物受伤那种事，她会告诉我的。

lines.en: : It’s just...weird. I’ve never had to deal with her keeping a secret before, so I can’t really wrap my head around what it might be.
lines.zh: : 就是……很怪。我从没应付过她瞒着秘密的情况，所以实在想不出能是什么事。

lines.en: : Do you think someone might have confessed to her again or something?
lines.zh: : 你觉得是不是又有人跟她表白了之类的？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe she finally found out what a dick is and just can’t mentally process it?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许她终于知道了「鸡巴」是什么，脑子里一时消化不了？

lines.en: : Your sister knows what is a dick is, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐知道鸡巴是什么，Kirin。

lines.en: scene mayanorikolockers34
: You can never be sure when it comes to things like this, Noriko. And if anyone knows about my sister’s history with dicks, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 这种事谁说得准呢，Noriko。要说谁最清楚我姐姐和鸡巴的历史，那就是我了。

lines.en: : I want to say that’s weird, but I can also completely relate.
lines.zh: : 我想说这很怪，但我又完全能理解。

lines.en: : Okay, okay, okay! Eyes over here, girls!
lines.zh: : 好了、好了、好了！眼睛看这边，姑娘们！
